architecture.fc_players: canonical athlete identity; one player can have N card items
architecture.fc_player_cards: Ultimate Team/base-dataset item; links through fc_player_id

fc_player_cards.identity_rule: Use a real provider_item_id when one exists. For EA base launch ratings with no distinct item id, provider_item_id may equal provider_player_id only when provider/card_type makes the namespace explicit.

rules: Do not merge special cards into base player identity.
EA ratings table is launch Gold/Silver/Bronze base items only; Heroes/Icons/Campaign items are separate.
Keep provider provenance on every row.
If provider_player_id is missing, preserve nullable fc_player_id behavior.
No destructive delete on refresh; deactivate missing items only after a complete successful provider run.
